answers.quote: Sangeet is used for the combination of three arts - vocal music, instrumental music and dance.
answers.notes: c01 defines Sangeet as vocal + instrumental + dance.

answers.quote: It is a matter of common knowledge to all music lovers that Indian classical music has its origin in the Saama Veda. Saama Veda is the selected collection of hymns from Rig Veda.
answers.notes: c02: origin in Sama Veda.

answers.quote: It is a matter of common knowledge to all music lovers that Indian classical music has its origin in the Saama Veda. Saama Veda is the selected collection of hymns from Rig Veda.
answers.notes: c02: Sama Veda is selected collection of hymns from Rig Veda.

answers.quote: The earliest chanting was the Rig Vedic hymns (3000 B.c. to 1500 B.c.).
answers.notes: c03: earliest chanting was Rig Vedic hymns.

answers.quote: The sacred sound "Om" was considered as the basic note of music.
answers.notes: c04: sacred sound Om was basic note.

answers.quote: The verses of the Saama - Veda served the purpose of musical notes. The musical notes emerged from the accents employed to sing the hymns.
answers.notes: c05 supports both statements.

answers.quote: The most important Shikshaas are the Naradi Shikshaa, Panini Shikshaa and Yagnavalkya Shikshaa which provide abundant information regarding the origin of svaras, vedic svaras, svaras of laukika gaana - the secular music.
answers.notes: c08 lists the three Shikshas.

answers.quote: Invaluable is contribution of Bharata Muni who authored the great treatise Natyashastra in Sanskrit in fifth century which was made him the first and foremost expert on Dramaturgy.
answers.notes: c12: Bharata Muni authored Natyashastra.

answers.quote: It is only in the Brihaddeshi that the term "Raaga" is found for the first time, and the aesthetic treatment of a raaga is discussed in detail.
answers.notes: c17: term Raaga first in Brihaddeshi.

answers.quote: It is only in the Brihaddeshi that the term "Raaga" is found for the first time, and the aesthetic treatment of a raaga is discussed in detail.
answers.notes: c17 names it Matanga's Brihaddeshi.

answers.quote: The first musicologist who defined the classification of ragas into Shuddha, Chaayalaga and Sankiran was Matanga.
answers.notes: c16: Matanga first defined Shuddha/Chhayalaga/Sankirna.

answers.quote: Vaadi is the dominant note in a musical phrase or a melody. Vaadi-note is compared to a king in the melody; Samvaadi is a note having harmonious relationship with the.note Vaadi or the tonic note.
answers.notes: c14: Vadi compared to a king.

answers.quote: Aarohi is the ascending of phrase of notes,Avrohi is the decending way of notes, Sthaayi is the repetition of the same note, Sanchaari is the combination of notes from different ranges.
answers.notes: c15: Aarohi is ascending phrase.

answers.quote: He says that the Naada is the most important aspect of music, there is no song, no svara, no dance without Naada.
answers.notes: c18 supports both A and R, R explains A.

answers.quote: A group of seven S waras in order is called saptak. As per convenience of a man's voice, mainly three saptaks are used in music.
answers.notes: c20 defines saptak.

answers.quote: Each saptak has seven shudha and five vikrit swaras.
answers.notes: c22 says a saptak contains twelve swaras (7 shudha + 5 vikrit), so total = 12; '৭টি' is also defensible from c20's seven-swara definition, hence LIKELY.

answers.quote: In present times, in popular Bhatkhande raga system, ten thats are recognized. The ten thats are1. Kalyan 2. Bilawal3.Khamaj  4.Bhairav 5.Poorvi 6.Marva 7.Kafi 8.Bhairvi 9.Asavari 1O.Todi
answers.notes: c24: ten thats recognised.

answers.notes: Stmt1 from c27, stmt2 from c28; both true.

answers.quote: Raga and tala are two main pillars of Indian music.
answers.notes: c29: raga and tala are two main pillars.

answers.quote: A laya is of three kinds - vilambit, madhya and drut, the madhya is doubly faster than vilarnbit and drut is doubly faster than madhya.
answers.notes: c30 claim text: laya is uniform pace of time in music.

answers.quote: A laya is of three kinds - vilambit, madhya and drut, the madhya is doubly faster than vilarnbit and drut is doubly faster than madhya.
answers.notes: c30: three kinds vilambit, madhya, drut.

answers.quote: The matra is the smallest measure. So tala has been invented by dividing matras into section. Talas are made by the collection of different matras as Dadra of six matras, Kaharwa of eight matras, Ektal of twelve matras, Teental of sixteen matras etc.
answers.notes: c32: Teental sixteen matras.

answers.quote: basically there was only one music in our country.After undergoing through many changes it converted into two distinct types of music.Now there are two mainstreams of classical music in India-Hindustani music and Karnatak music.
answers.notes: c19: two mainstreams Hindustani and Karnatak.

answers.quote: Indian classical music is very closely connected to nature, taking inspiration from natural phenomena including the seasons and times of the day to create ‘ragas’ or musical moods and many time cycles or ‘taals’ that have been further codified.
answers.notes: c38: inspiration from seasons and times of day.

answers.quote: Shri Shivkumar is today synonymous with the Santoor, which he has helped to establish as an instrument used in Hindustani classical music.
answers.notes: c59: Sharma synonymous with Santoor.

answers.quote: This has enriched Hindustani music and attracted new artists to this instrument of Kashmir.
answers.notes: c60: santoor is instrument of Kashmir.

answers.quote: Compositions are fixed but most of the music is improvised within the structure of notes and mathematics.
answers.notes: c39 supports both statements.

answers.quote: Born on 13 January 1938 in Jammu, Shri Shivkumar Sharma received his training in Hindustani music from his father Umadutt Sharma, a disciple of Pandit Bade Ram Das of the Benaras gharana.

answers.quote: Sangeet Natak Akademi, the apex body in the field of performing arts in the country, was set up in 1953 for the preservation and promotion of the vast intangible heritage of India’s diverse culture expressed in forms of music, dance and drama.
answers.notes: c41: Akademi set up in 1953 (1961 in c43 is society registration, not set-up).

answers.quote: Tradition of Vedic Chanting was inscribed in 2008 on the Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity (originally proclaimed in 2003).
answers.notes: c48: inscribed 2008 on Representative List (2003 was original proclamation).

answers.quote: Sankirtan was inscribed in 2013 on the Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity.
answers.notes: c50: Sankirtana inscribed 2013.

answers.quote: Sangeet Natak Akademi is an autonomous body of the Ministry of Culture, Government of India.
answers.notes: c42: autonomous body of Ministry of Culture.

answers.quote: The Sangeet Natak Akademi Awards are the highest national recognition conferred on practising artists. The Akademi also confers Fellowships on eminent artists and scholars of music, dance and drama; and has in 2006 instituted annual awards to young artists – the Ustad Bismillah Khan Yuva Puraskar.
answers.notes: c44: Yuva Puraskar instituted in 2006.
